rtl-sdr-01.notes: Generic RTL-SDR dongle. CANNOT capture 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. Use 433.92 MHz ISM test emitter band or sub-GHz sensors.

hackrf-01.notes: Wideband 1 MHz-6 GHz capable of 2.4 GHz, but not yet wired/validated in this deployment.

pluto-01.notes: PlutoSDR capable of 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi band IF actually deployed and calibrated; not currently owned.
